== Template:Item/Charm ==

Master template for displaying complete charm tooltips. Charms modify how effectively your character utilizes stats through scaling modifiers.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Charm name
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''tier''' || No || Quality tier: 0=Normal (default), 1=Blessed, 2=Godly
|-
| '''strscaling''' || No || Strength scaling modifier
|-
| '''endscaling''' || No || Endurance scaling modifier
|-
| '''dexscaling''' || No || Dexterity scaling modifier
|-
| '''agiscaling''' || No || Agility scaling modifier
|-
| '''intscaling''' || No || Intelligence scaling modifier
|-
| '''wisscaling''' || No || Wisdom scaling modifier
|-
| '''chascaling''' || No || Charisma scaling modifier
|-
| '''resistscaling''' || No || Resist scaling modifier
|-
| '''mitigationscaling''' || No || Mitigation/Armor scaling modifier
|-
| '''arcanist, duelist, druid, paladin, reaver, stormcaller''' || No || Class restrictions (set to any value)
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Charm
|image=Charm of Age.png
|name=Charm of Age
|tier=0
|wisscaling=4
|arcanist=1
|duelist=1
|druid=1
|paladin=1
|stormcaller=1
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Charm
|image=Charm of Age.png
|name=Charm of Age
|tier=0
|wisscaling=4
|arcanist=1
|duelist=1
|druid=1
|paladin=1
|stormcaller=1
}}

----

=== Sub-templates Used ===

* [[Template:Item/Header]] - Icon and name display
* [[Template:Item/CharmScaling]] - Scaling modifiers display
* [[Template:Item/ClassRestrictions]] - Class usability
* [[Template:Item/Categories]] - Auto-categorization
